fields.toolCallId: Native call ID, including nested <parent>/<n> IDs
fields.parentToolCallId: Enclosing native call ID or null
fields.kind: read/edit/write/exec/net/send for the named versioned allowlist of built-in tools; null for anything else, never a guess
fields.allowlistVersion: Pi version the built-in tool allowlist was written against (text)
fields.argv: Sanitized scalar argument strings; never credentials, never free-text bodies
fields.withheldParams: Free-text parameter names deliberately excluded from argv (command/content/text/prompt/message and the like)
fields.redactionNote: Which redaction applied: writer sanitizeArgv plus tool-specific scalar filtering
